answer: Tie each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof each epoch, and let standing accrue only as already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work: each honest agent moored at its own jetty, not a flag anyone can plant. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches fold back onto one jetty and never span clusters; its lantern of reputation stays unlit. Honest trust ripens slowly like nectar gathered blossom by blossom, so a farm pays a fresh anchor per head while an honest root pays once.
